simple.meaning: טָמַן (ṭâman) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to hide (by covering over).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 31 times in Genesis, Exodus, Deuteronomy, Joshua, 2 Kings, and 5 more, beginning at Genesis 35:4. The surrounding contexts include death, mountain, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to טָמַן (H2934) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: טָמַן (ṭâman) / H2934 is traced through Genesis 35:4, Exodus 2:12, Deuteronomy 33:19, Joshua 2:6 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H2934. taman טָמַן verb hide, conceal , especially in earth (Late Hebrew id. ; whence perhaps Aramaic טְמֵן keep, preserve ; compare Arabic bury, hide (loan-word Frä 137 ); Aramaic , טְמַר id. ); — Qal Perfect טְמֵן Psa 35:8 2 t. etc; Imperfect וַיִּטְמֹן Gen 35:4 , etc.; Imperative suffix טָמְנֵהוּ Jer 13:4 ; טָמְנֵם Job 40:13 ; Infinitive construct לִטְמוֺן 31:33 ; Psa 64:6 ; Passive participle טָמוּן Job 3:16 3 t.; טְמוּנָה Josh 7:22 ; plural טְמֻנִים 7:21 ; construct טְמוּנֵי Deut 33:19 ; — 1 hide , with accusative Gen 35:4 (E), Exod 2:12 (E; dead body in sand), Josh 2:6 (J E; spies under flax-stalks), 7:21-22 , (J E; Achan's theft), Jer 13:4-5 , 6 , 7 (Jeremiah's girdle), 43:9-10 , (stones at Tahpanhes); hide, bury hand in dish ( צַלָּ֑חַת ) Prov 19:24 ; 26:15 (of עָצֵל the sluggard); טָמוּן נֵפֶל Job 3:16 hidden abortion , i.e. a lifeless child at once buried; חול טְמוּנֵי שְׂפֻנֵי Deut 33:19 (poem); of hiding iniquity עון Job 31:33 ; hiding the wicked in the dust עפר 40:13 . 2 often of hiding, concealing, secretly laying a snare רֶשֶׁת Psa 9:16 ; 35:8 , followed by לִי 31:5 ; רִשְׁתָּם שַׁחַת 35:7 ; מַּח followed by לִי 140:6 ; 142:4 ; followed by לרגלי Jer 18:22 ; חבל Job 18:10 ; מוֺקשׁים Psa 64:5 . 3 טָמוּן that which is darkened = darkness , Job 40:13 nearly = בט חֲבשׁ ׳פניהם ׃שְׁאוֺל bind their faces in darkness (i.e. the wicked); hide = reserve 20:26 all darkness is held in reserve for his treasures , i.e. all calamities are stored up for them. Niph`al Imperative י מַּחַד ׳מִמְּנֵי בֶּעָפָר חִטָּמֵן Isa 2:10 hide thyself in the dust, from before the terror of ׳י . Hiph`il (or Qal ? Ba ZMG 1889, 180 ) Imperfect וַיַּטְמִנוּ וַיֵּלִכוּ 2Kin 7:8 (twice in verse) and they went and hid (it), i.e. plunder from Aramaic camp.
